newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal not expected to cut rates - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal not expected to cut rates - poll.

text.p: All 10 analysts polled by Reuters on Wednesday said the Bank of Portugal would keep its key money market rates unchanged when it sets conditions on Friday for the next commercial bank cash reserves period.
All 10 also agreed that the central bank had room to cut rates but would probably wait until after April consumer price inflation data which is due by the middle of next month.
The Bank's repurchase pact rate currently stands at 6.30 percent. Its rate for absorbing funds is 5.80 percent and its emergency rate for one-day funds is 7.80 percent.
The central bank last cut rates on April 11 when it took 20 basis points off the repo rate and 40 off the drain rate.

The following banks and brokerages took part in the poll and agreed to be identified: Banco Finantia, Banco Portugues de Investimento, Banco Mello de Investimentos, Banco de Comercio e Industria, Credit Lyonnais Portugal, IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Banco Essi.
